start_timestamp.meaning: supplied startTimestamp parameter of the campaign being created

campaign_duration.meaning: duration of the campaign being created, at least 1 hour

block_timestamp_at_creation.meaning: block.timestamp at the moment of campaign creation

start_timestamp_in_past.meaning: the supplied startTimestamp is in the past relative to block.timestamp, including a campaign already fully elapsed before creation

full_fees_paid_for_nondistributing_campa.meaning: users pay full fees and token amounts for a campaign that can never distribute rewards

assumptions: The campaign duration is measured in seconds and the 1-hour minimum equals 3600 seconds.
startTimestamp and block.timestamp are comparable timestamp quantities.

unresolved.description: The intent requires startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp, but the temporal_order pattern only compares two symbols and cannot express the sum of startTimestamp and duration against block.timestamp; the duration term cannot be folded into the ordering without inventing a derived quantity.

limitations: The impact's fee and token amounts are not quantified; V is encoded as a grounded Boolean outcome.
Whether the distributor actually ignores such campaigns is described as uncertain in the report.
